procedure.label: PLATFORM PROCEDURE
procedure.title: Simple 4-Step Process
procedure.subtitle: Four simple AI-driven steps to guide your career path from start to achievement.

step1.title: Upload Your CV
step1.desc: Upload your CV in PDF or DOCX format. Our AI instantly parses and analyzes your qualifications.
step1.detail: Don't have a CV yet? You can build one from scratch with our step-by-step AI wizard.

step2.title: AI Understands Potential
step2.desc: AI evaluates your experience, technical skills, education, and career aspirations across industries.
step2.detail: Far beyond simple keyword matching — our AI understands the complete context of your career.

step3.title: Receive Deep Insights
step3.desc: Get a full career profile, ATS score, targeted job recommendations, and actionable growth steps.
step3.detail: Delivered in a sleek, modern, interactive interface ready for instant action.

step4.title: Ready to Apply
step4.desc: Create & optimize Harvard ATS-formatted CVs, fully prepared to land your dream career.
step4.detail: You won't just know what roles fit — you'll be empowered to secure them.

features.label: KEY FEATURES
features.title: Everything You Need

features.f1Desc: Deep AI breakdown of your CV — ATS score, strengths, weak spots, and concrete improvement feedback.

features.f3Desc: Receive structured career trajectory guidance tailored precisely to your background.
features.f4Desc: Step-by-step milestone mapping from your current position straight to your target role.

features.f6Desc: Create persuasive & professional cover letters tailored automatically to your dream position.
features.f7Desc: Instant assessment based on modern automated hiring algorithms and ATS screening criteria.
